title: Adaptive sampling and SLI heatmaps for analytics ingestion
creator: Maya Chen
description: Define and implement an adaptive sampling strategy for the analytics ingestion pipeline and add a set of SLI heatmaps to detect localized degradation. Goal: reduce tracing ingest cost by ~40% on high-throughput tenants while preserving signal for regression detection, and provide product-facing heatmaps that quickly surface per-tenant ingestion latency and error hotspots.
updates: 2025-11-05: Kickoff meeting with Observability and Ingest teams. Agreed on three initial goals: (1) per-tenant adaptive sampling, (2) SLI heatmaps for latency/error rates by route and time-window, (3) alerting thresholds for regressions. Action: prototype sampling algorithm with tail-preserving bias.

2025-11-18: Prototype sampling implemented in analytics-proxy (branch: feat/adm-sample-proto). Early local benchmarks show 35% reduction in span volume with negligible change to median latency SLO violation detection. Shared prototype notes in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OBS/Adaptive+Sampling+Prototype

2025-12-02: Trade-off discussion: full deterministic head-sampling vs. reservoir with priority bias. Decided on a hybrid approach: deterministic retention for error/slow traces, probabilistic reservoir for normal traces. Rationale: ensures rare failures and tail latency remain visible while reducing volume. Documented trade-offs in design doc.

2026-01-10: Integration test with ingestion pipeline. Observed a regression: KV cache miss correlation lost for 2% of sampled traces because sampling dropped early prefix spans. Mitigation: update sampler to tag and always retain first span of request chain. Incident note: ING-2026-01-kv-cache-trace-loss (see postmortem link).

2026-01-22: Dashboard mockups reviewed by PM and Design. Feedback: heatmap color scales should be tenant-normalized and allow switching between absolute and z-score views. PRD updated: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/console-analytics-heatmaps

2026-02-05: Implemented heatmap backend aggregation job (spark-job v2) emitting per-tenant, per-route 5m buckets. Added Grafana panels under workspace 'console/analytics/heatmaps'. Grafana link: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/analytics-heatmaps

2026-02-15: RFC review with SRE: alert thresholds will use an adaptive baseline (rolling 7d median + 3 sigma) instead of fixed SLO buckets to reduce noise for spiky tenants. SRE requested an opt-out label for critical tenants to use fixed SLO policy. Added to scope as follow-up sub-issue.

2026-02-27: Code review pending for sampler rollout gate and migration script. Preparing canary plan: enable adaptive sampling for 5% of traffic per region for two weeks, monitor trace coverage and SLI delta. Canary runbook drafted: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OBS/Adaptive+Sampling+Canary+Runbook
